powerGrid.note: Fighting skills bar is 146 px on the 21 px-per-point scale, read as 7.

powerOrigins.detail: Raised and trained from childhood by his father to be an assassin; his main edge is unmatched martial arts skill.
Can focus his mystical chi to push his strength, durability, healing and reflexes past human limits.
Now wields the Ten Rings, which grant superhuman power; a healing factor comes from his immortal father's herbal remedy.

abilities.name: Master martial artist
abilities.detail: Widely called the world's greatest martial artist, expert in every martial art on Earth, including kung fu and the Dragon, Leopard and Crane styles.

abilities.name: Pressure-point strikes
abilities.detail: Knows exactly where to strike to knock out or immobilise a foe, even pressure points shared by animals.

abilities.name: Chi augmentation
abilities.detail: Channels his chi to break brick, concrete and iron, endure heavy impacts, heal burns and poison quickly and dodge point-blank gunfire.

abilities.name: Peak human condition
abilities.detail: Trained to the top of human strength, speed and stamina: he has kept pace with a subway train and survived a bear hug from the Thing.

abilities.name: Weapons master
abilities.detail: Highly skilled with swords, staves and nunchaku, improvises with pipes or tree trunks, and throws shuriken with pinpoint accuracy.

abilities.name: Nervous system control
abilities.detail: Can deaden pain, resist drugs and poisons, slow the spread of toxins and reduce his own bleeding.

abilities.name: The Ten Rings
abilities.detail: Wearing the Ten Rings gives him superhuman strength, speed and durability, plus flight, energy blasts, force fields, portals and teleportation.

feats.text: Grown to giant size with Pym Particles, he tore the Gorgon's headquarters off Madripoor, threw it miles away and beat a dragon in combat.

sources.label: Marvel Fandom wiki: Avengers World Vol 1 14

feats.text: Disabled the Thing's arm with a single pressure-point strike.
Lured Iron Man into the House of the Deadly Hand's arsenal and fought his armour with adamantium-plated weapons, taking one of his gauntlets.
On a runaway San Francisco bus he fought off Ten Rings agents and Razor Fist, threw attackers off and got the passengers out safely.

feats.text: Fought Ten Rings agents on scaffolding high above Macau, then came close to beating the assassin Death Dealer before his father intervened.
